clue.text: Girl houses mate and mother in the canaries

indicators.note: the girl's name holds the other two pieces inside it, as a house holds its occupants

parts.note: a lass is a girl
a pal is a mate or friend
ma is an informal word for mother

explanation.surface: A girl shares her home with her friend and her mother while living among pet songbirds.
explanation.walkthrough: The lower-case 'canaries' disguises the Canary Islands, a Spanish archipelago.
explanation.definitionFit: The city is the capital of Gran Canaria, one of the Canary Islands.

clue.text: Free French needed time to write musical text

parts.note: libre is the French word for free
taken as written

explanation.surface: A Frenchman needed time to write the words for a musical.
explanation.definitionFit: The written words of an opera or musical are its book, its sung text.

clue.text: Drive away solicitor from gangland battle

parts.note: to shoo is to drive away, as with a cat
a tout solicits custom, so a solicitor here is someone touting, not a lawyer

explanation.surface: A lawyer is chased out of a gang war.
explanation.walkthrough: 'solicitor' looks like a lawyer but is someone who solicits business, a tout.
explanation.definitionFit: A gunfight between rival criminals is the classic gangland battle.

clue.text: Lawsuit brought by leaderless splinter group

indicators.note: without its leader, so the opening letter of the word for a splinter group is dropped

parts.note: a faction is a breakaway group within a party

explanation.surface: A legal case is brought by a breakaway group with no head.
explanation.definitionFit: A legal action is a case brought in court, a suit.

clue.text: Childish toy made of hard stone

explanation.surface: A toy for children is carved from hard rock.
explanation.definitionFit: Children play with small glass balls of this name, and it is also a hard crystalline limestone used by sculptors.

clue.text: Betray first female cabinet-maker

indicators.note: tells us the female pronoun is placed at the front, ahead of the betrayal word

parts.note: she is the female pronoun
to rat on someone is to betray them

explanation.surface: The first woman to make cabinets is betrayed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cabinet-maker' suggests a prime minister forming a government; it is the furniture designer Thomas Sheraton.
explanation.definitionFit: Thomas Sheraton was an eighteenth-century English furniture designer whose name became a furniture style.

clue.text: Buffalo bill's first show is being staged

indicators.note: only the opening letter of the word bill's is used

parts.note: taken as written
a show that is being staged is on

explanation.surface: Buffalo Bill's first Wild West show is being put on.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads 'Buffalo bill' as the showman Buffalo Bill Cody; 'Buffalo' is the definition on its own.
explanation.definitionFit: The American buffalo is properly a bison, a large wild ox.

clue.text: Gradually put two mouthpieces together

parts.note: a bit is the mouthpiece of a horse's bridle, and two are wanted
by means beside, next to, so the two bits sit together
a bit is the mouthpiece of a horse's bridle, and two are wanted

explanation.surface: Fitting two bridle bits side by side.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something a little piece at a time is doing it slowly, gradually.

clue.text: Carriage taking laurel to church

parts.note: Stan Laurel was the comic partner of Oliver Hardy
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A coach takes laurel wreaths to a church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'laurel' looks like the plant, but stands for Stan Laurel of Laurel and Hardy.
explanation.definitionFit: Carriage means bearing or posture, the way one stands.

clue.text: Constructing saunas requires capital

indicators.note: building or putting together, so the letters of saunas are rearranged

explanation.surface: Building saunas needs money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' looks like money; it is the capital city of the Bahamas.
explanation.definitionFit: This city is the capital of the Bahamas.

clue.text: He encourages one to get an amplifier

explanation.surface: A cheerleader picks up a loudspeaker.
explanation.definitionFit: A supporter who talks things up is a promoter, and an electrical device that increases signal strength has the same name.

clue.text: A few facts about skeletons

explanation.surface: A handful of details concerning skeletons.
explanation.definitionFit: Only the essential facts are the bare essentials, and a skeleton is literally stripped, uncovered bones.

clue.text: No truce arranged, despite defeat

indicators.note: put in a new order, so the letters of no truce are rearranged

explanation.surface: No ceasefire was agreed, though the side had lost.
explanation.definitionFit: To thrash or beat soundly is to defeat heavily.

clue.text: Picture dining area trimmed with gold

indicators.note: edged or finished with, so the gold symbol is added at the end

parts.note: a table is where one dines
Au is the chemical symbol for gold

explanation.surface: A painting shows a dining room with gilded trim.
explanation.definitionFit: A tableau is a striking scene or picture, as in a living picture staged by actors.

clue.text: Misguided hounds may be off the scent

definitions.text: hounds may be off the scent

explanation.surface: Mistaken dogs lose the smell they were following.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone in error is heading the wrong way, and hounds that lose the scent are literally following the wrong path.

clue.text: Listen to cockney ads? Not with these in!

indicators.note: a London cockney drops the H sound, so the opening H of the listening word goes

parts.note: to hear is to listen
plugs are advertisements

explanation.surface: Asked to listen to adverts in a cockney accent, someone refuses while wearing ear protection.
explanation.walkthrough: Cockneys, working-class Londoners, famously drop their aitches.
explanation.definitionFit: Small stoppers placed in the ears block sound, so with them in one could not hear anything.

clue.text: Fabulous storyteller

parts.note: fabulous in its root sense of telling fables: a teller of fanciful tales, or a fantasist who exaggerates

explanation.definitionFit: A writer of fanciful tales, or someone given to exaggeration, invents stories like a fabulist.

clue.text: Forgiveness granted without so ritual a wash

indicators.note: lacking, so the letters of so are taken out

parts.note: absolution is forgiveness granted by a priest
taken as written

explanation.surface: Forgiveness is given without such ceremony as a ritual washing.
explanation.definitionFit: Washing the body, especially as a religious rite, is a cleansing.

clue.text: Gee! Derek has made a meal!

indicators.note: the letters are made into something new, so Gee and Derek are rearranged

explanation.surface: An exclamation of delight as Derek cooks dinner.
explanation.definitionFit: Kedgeree is a dish of rice, smoked fish and eggs, eaten as a meal.

clue.text: Aileen and Elaine, for instance

parts.note: the two names use exactly the same letters in different orders, so each is a rearrangement of the other

explanation.definitionFit: A word formed by reordering another's letters, as these two names are of each other.

clue.text: A fine show, but it generates concern

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for fine, as on pencils
a fair is a show or exhibition

explanation.surface: A fine show, but it causes worry.
explanation.definitionFit: An affair is a matter or business, something that is one's concern.

clue.text: Programme reaches a conclusion in Georgia

indicators.note: the conclusion word sits inside the abbreviation for the state

parts.note: GA is the US postal abbreviation for Georgia
an end is a conclusion

explanation.surface: A TV programme reaches its finale in the American state of Georgia.
explanation.definitionFit: A list of business to be dealt with at a meeting is its programme or schedule.

clue.text: Belt's fastened, but out of shape

explanation.surface: The seatbelt is done up, but the car has been crumpled.
explanation.definitionFit: A belt done up with its clasp is secured that way, and metal that has bent or warped under pressure has also given way in this sense.

clue.text: Ambassador gets a1 housing by order

indicators.note: holding inside, so the ambassador's title goes within the word for a1

parts.note: A1 means first-rate, the best
HE, His Excellency, is the title of an ambassador

explanation.surface: An envoy gets top-quality accommodation by command.
explanation.walkthrough: An ambassador is addressed as His Excellency, abbreviated HE.
explanation.definitionFit: At someone's behest means at their command, so the word itself names a command.

clue.text: Travelling in a vehicle richly adorned is divine

indicators.note: the answer rides inside the words vehicle richly, as a passenger in a car

explanation.surface: Riding in a lavishly decorated car is heavenly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'divine' looks like an adjective, but as a noun it means a clergyman or theologian.
explanation.definitionFit: A divine is a priest or churchman, a member of the clergy.

clue.text: At liberty to eat? There's no such thing!

parts.note: free means at liberty
lunch is something to eat, a meal

explanation.surface: Someone free to eat is told it will cost them after all.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition quotes the saying that there is no such thing as a meal for nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: The proverb says nothing comes without a cost, so a gratis meal does not exist.

clue.text: Prior always covers for devious liar

indicators.note: wraps round, so the poetic always goes outside the rearranged letters

parts.note: e'er is a poetic contraction of ever, always

indicators.note: crooked or not straight, so the letters of liar are rearranged

explanation.surface: A monastery head always protects a lying monk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Prior' looks like a monk; it is the adjective meaning before.
explanation.definitionFit: Prior means coming before in time, sooner.

clue.text: Lots of them are bores

explanation.surface: Many people find them tedious.
explanation.definitionFit: Reams of paper means great quantities, and to ream is to widen a hole with a boring tool.

clue.text: Reserve nice compound in Crete, perhaps

indicators.note: mix together, so the letters of nice and Crete are combined in a new order

explanation.surface: A nature reserve sits in a pleasant walled settlement on a Greek island.
explanation.definitionFit: Reticence is restraint in speaking, a quiet reserve.
